title: Department of Energy: DOE Implementation of the Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act
publisher: Department of Energy Office of Inspector General
summary: DOE OIG found that the department took the actions necessary to implement the Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act requirements reviewed. Phase 56E entity use: DOE's later records show continuing FISMA and access-control work alongside a bounded 2026 statutory determination that the reviewed sharing requirements were implemented.
key_findings: The evaluation found sufficient policies and procedures and no identified sharing impact from the noted information-quality fatigue barrier.
Entity layer: DOE unclassified cybersecurity program.
Compatibility boundary: Same department but different audit objectives, tested controls, and denominators.
